name: Audra M. Mori
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Four

items.text: Audra M. Mori has been an associate justice of the Second District Court of Appeal, Division Four, since 2023. She was previously a Los Angeles County Superior Court judge and managing partner at Perkins Coie. Her appellate opinions include Greenspan v. County of Los Angeles (2023), holding the assessor violated tax law, and People v. Millsap (2025), ruling a trial court lacked authority to resentence during a capital appeal.
